scope: Actual POST /api/studio/playlists handler and Prisma transactions against a disposable PostgreSQL 17 database after all 84 migrations.

test.command: DATABASE_URL=<disposable PostgreSQL 17> DATABASE_URL_UNPOOLED=<same> npx vitest run --config vitest.postgres.config.ts tests/postgres/playlist-limit-concurrency.pg.test.ts
test.new_case: At 99 active playlists, two concurrent calls through the actual Studio POST handler returned exactly one 201 and one 409 PLAYLIST_LIMIT; final active count was 100 and exactly one PLAYLIST_CREATED audit row existed for the committed request.
test.existing_cases: Two separate Node processes concurrently exercise the actual use case/authz; slot reuse after soft delete; foreign-channel refusal; exactly one audit row; and no cross-channel advisory-lock blocking.

controlled_boundaries: Studio session resolver returned synthetic test sessions.
Studio rate limiter was stubbed to allow these requests.
The PostgreSQL container used tmpfs on loopback and was removed after the run; its synthetic rows were destroyed with it.
No deployed multi-process HTTP, production, external storage, or external service was used.
remaining: K25 stays partial pending deployed non-production POST/DELETE across separate HTTP processes and independent review.
